purpose: Teach: 月収/出来高/同上/組合せ/既定/特約/あっせん/引き渡し

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、若手警察官の月収改善が話題ですね
lines.en: There's been quite a bit of discussion lately about improving salaries for young officers in the police force.
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Even tone, slightly formal. The ease of someone used to official conversations. Clear articulation on key words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、出来高ノルマで現場が疲弊しないようご配慮、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful that you're being considerate about preventing burnout on the ground with performance-based quotas.
lines.style: Respectful, earnest. Slightly careful phrasing — diplomatic without sounding insincere. Steady pace. A hint of relief underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、報告書の項目は同上で省略しないように指導します
lines.en: I'll make sure to instruct the team that report sections should be filled in completely — no shortcuts using the ditto mark.
lines.style: Firm, instructional but not unkind. Crisp attack on the key directive. Professional distance. The tone of someone setting a clear standard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、犯罪パターンの組合せ分析、進められてますね
lines.en: Yes. I see you've been making progress on analyzing the combinations and patterns in criminal cases.
lines.style: Attentive, encouraging. Slight nod in the voice — acknowledging the work. Conversational but measured. The tone of someone checking in on a colleague.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、既定の捜査手順に従います
lines.en: We follow the established investigation procedures without deviation.
lines.style: Declarative, settled. No negotiation in the tone. Quiet confidence. The finality of someone stating protocol as anchor.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、保険特約詐欺の事件を捜査されてますね
lines.en: Yes. I understand you're currently investigating that insurance fraud case with the special coverage claims.
lines.style: Attentive, following the thread. Steady, engaged. A light question underneath — confirmation more than surprise. Even pacing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、違法あっせん業者を摘発します
lines.en: We're moving forward with criminal charges against the unlicensed brokers operating illegally.
lines.style: Determined, purposeful. Weight on the key words. The resolve of someone ready to act. Steady, unflinching delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、容疑者の引き渡し手続が完了されましたね
lines.en: Yes. The handover procedures for the suspect have been completed as scheduled.
lines.style: Quiet finality. Professional relief — the closing of one phase. Even pace, slight exhale at the end. The tone of checking something off.
